answer: Commit the hash, wait 2 blocks, reveal. The receipt splits into 4 shards, each checked by a different auditor, so no single auditor sees enough to fake a pass. Cost: 3 txs and 4 signatures per receipt. A receipt is a relic the next maintainer must be able to re-run, which is why a walnut of noise with a valid hash fails the shard check and the epoch pulse moves on without it.
